decisionPolicy.resolveRule: Resolve only a choice compelled by user authority, an adopted Masterplan 05 statement, or a reversible fail-closed omission expressly allowed by that plan.
decisionPolicy.holdRule: Keep a decision on HOLD when resolution would invent geometry, materials, safety engineering, factual wording, ownership, survey evidence, or release authority.
decisionPolicy.scopeOmissionMeaning: Deleting or deferring an unbuilt proposal removes it from active construction scope; it never authorizes physical demolition.
decisionPolicy.releaseEvidenceBoundary: Operations, source guards, manifests, preflights, live-entity clearance, pilots, execution, rollback, route QA, and post-state QA belong to G03-G19 and cannot resolve a G02 design decision.
